item.text: {"action":"batch","arguments_json":"{\"calls\":[{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-m\",\"py_compile\",\"work.py\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import copy,json; from work import evaluate; p={'edges':{'a>b':{},'b>c':{'role':'op'},'c>d':{'role':'op','retry':True}},'retry_limit':2}; cases=[({'from':'x','to':'y'},'blocked'),({'from':'b','to':'c','role':'no'},'permission'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'no','attempts':False},'permission'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op'},'retry_limit'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':True},'retry_limit'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':-1},'retry_limit'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':2},'retry_limit'),({'from':'c','to':'d','role':'op','attempts':1},'ok'),({'from':'a','to':'b','retry':True},'ok')]; before=copy.deepcopy(p); results=[];\\nfor r,want in cases:\\n rb=copy.deepcopy(r); got=evaluate(r,p); assert got['reason']==want,(r,got,want); assert set(got)=={'ok','value','reason'}; assert r==rb\\n results.append(got)\\nassert p==before; print(json.dumps(results))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"python\",\"-c\",\"import json; from work import evaluate; p=json.load(open('policy.json')); rs=json.load(open('requests.json')); expected=[evaluate(r,p) for r in rs]; actual=json.load(open('report.json')); assert actual==expected,(actual,expected); assert all(set(x)=={'ok','value','reason'} for x in actual); print(json.dumps(actual))\"]}},{\"action\":\"run\",\"arguments\":{\"command\":[\"git\",\"diff\",\"--\",\"work.py\",\"report.json\"]}}]}"}
